datasetId.title: Screenshot dataset ID
datasetId.description: Dataset ID produced by the screenshot Actor.

manifest.title: Ordered report manifest
manifest.description: Ordered profile screenshot, post screenshots and additional direct-photo entries.

kind.title: Entry type
kind.description: profile and post use screenshot datasets; photo uses imageUrl directly.

url.title: Source URL
url.description: Facebook page URL used for the screenshot.

postNumber.title: Post number
postNumber.description: Position of the parent post in the report.

photoId.title: Photo ID
photoId.description: Facebook photo identifier, when this entry is a photo.

imageUrl.title: Direct photo image URL
imageUrl.description: Original image URL returned by the Photos Scraper; required for photo entries.

photoUrl.title: Photo viewer URL
photoUrl.description: Photo viewer URL for an additional photo.

storageKey.title: Cached image record key
storageKey.description: Cached image record key for an additional photo.

storageId.title: Cached image store ID
storageId.description: Cached image store ID for an additional photo.

downloadError.title: Photo download failure
downloadError.description: Photo download failure for an additional photo.

marginPoints.title: Margin points
marginPoints.description: Margin around screenshots in PDF points.

trimWhiteEdges.title: Trim white edges
trimWhiteEdges.description: Remove white image borders before fitting on PDF page.

maxImageHeight.title: Maximum image height
maxImageHeight.description: Maximum raster height in pixels; 0 disables resizing.

profileDatasetId.title: Profile screenshot dataset ID
profileDatasetId.description: Optional separate dataset containing the unscrolled profile screenshot.

jpegQuality.title: JPEG image quality
jpegQuality.description: JPEG quality for embedded images, 1–100. Default 85; 0 disables JPEG compression.
